title: В Иране заявили, что новый конфликт с США может оказаться дольше предыдущего

title: Муся Тотибадзе выпустила четвертый альбом «Сон»

snippet: Bulgaria’s acting president Iliana Iotova, who favours dialogue with Moscow and opposes military aid to Ukraine, won a presidential run-off vote on Sunday, exit polls showed. The vote took place amid security concerns in the European Union and Nato member following a series of drone attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea. The race for the largely ceremonial post pitted Iotova, an ally of Prime Minister Rumen Radev, against Andrey Gyurov, a banker and former caretaker prime minister...

title: Why the 'elite overproduction' theory is misunderstanding young people's anger
snippet: The idea that there is a causal link between an excess of elites and social crises has provided conservative circles with an explanation for youth malaise, one that many sociologists have challenged. According to them, disenchantment stems from the failure of the promised equality of opportunity to materialize.
